answer.rationale: Use the confirmed onboarding improvement rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. Shorter onboarding increased completion, accelerated time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, while the verified promotional-pricing cohort produced qualified-revenue lift but suffered a 12% retention decline and was explicitly judged unsustainable. Roll out broadly across self-serve SMB while monitoring renewal-stage churn, since the evidence supports early retention but does not prove longer-term survival.
